# ssh_metadata (Data Source)

Metadata data source



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ssh` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--ssh))

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String) Metadata identifier
- `ip_address` (String) Primary private address of the host.
- `ip_addresses` (List of String) All available private addresses of the host.

<a id="nestedblock--ssh"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssh`

Optional:

- `host` (String) SSH host
- `password` (String, Sensitive) SSH password
- `port` (String) SSH port
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) SSH private key data
